proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ G _ u v hf huv
  have hd : Disjoint (G.neighborFinset u) (G.neighborFinset v) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro w hu hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] at hu hv
    exact hf {u, v, w} (SimpleGraph.is3Clique_triple_iff.mpr ⟨huv, hu, hv⟩)
  have := Finset.card_le_univ (G.neighborFinset u ∪ G.neighborFinset v)
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at this
  exact this
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (u v : V), G.CliqueFree 3 → G.Adj u v → G.degree u + G.degree v ≤ Fintype.card V
